summary: Static GitHub Pages / single-file architecture is sound for the current dsv-demo deployment shape.
Privacy boundaries are explicit enough for a demo because the plan requires customer projection and filtered map data, not merely hidden admin panels.
Latest user corrections are reflected: no order input/sample selection, normal title controls, and Settings shortcut access.
ralplan_architect_review.steelman_antithesis: A separate delivery-inquiry.html would provide harder isolation and lower accidental admin-data leakage risk than a query-mode branch inside the existing single file.
ralplan_architect_review.tradeoff_tension: Same-file query mode minimizes duplication and preserves ETA/simulation consistency; a separate page strengthens isolation but duplicates route/simulation logic and increases drift risk.
ralplan_architect_review.synthesis_path: Keep same-file query mode, but make customer mode a strict filtered projection with tests proving admin chrome is absent, only one customer vehicle/destination is rendered, and vehicle click reveals only the customer route context.
ralplan_architect_review.required_execution_note: Customer mode must filter underlying map/data sources, not merely hide panels.

mandatory_improvements: Specify exact customer fixture and privacy-safe route semantics.

summary: The revision answers the critic blockers: exact query contract, exact customer fixture, mandatory privacy/source filtering, startup/click mode guards, and a testable evidence path.
Same-file query mode is acceptable because the current app is a single HTML surface with centralized startup, page-mode toggling, and shared map-data pipeline.
The revised fixture/projection/test-hook contracts are sufficient for implementation handoff.
ralplan_architect_rereview.steelman_antithesis: A separate delivery-inquiry.html would create a harder privacy boundary and reduce the chance of accidentally exposing admin data through shared state.
ralplan_architect_rereview.tradeoff_tension: Same-file mode minimizes duplication and preserves ETA/simulation consistency, but concentrates privacy risk in one branching startup/update path.
ralplan_architect_rereview.synthesis_path: Keep the same file, but treat customer mode as a strict projection layer with mandatory snapshot/source-count tests so the privacy guarantee is verified, not implied.
recommendations: Proceed with same-file customer mode using a strict filtered projection.
Make customerSnapshot reflect raw source reality, not just UI state.

summary: All five mandatory improvements are present.
Principle/option consistency, alternatives depth, risk mitigation, acceptance criteria, and executable verification pass.
customerSnapshot/source-count checks are acceptable because the plan also requires MapLibre/source inspection and raw projected data grounding.
ralplan_critic_review.optional_execution_caution: Implement customerSnapshot from actual projected MapLibre/source data or the same object passed into setSource(), not from static fixture constants, so the privacy test proves the rendered customer projection.
